name: Eastvale Logging Camp
summary: Timber orders from Stormwind reach Eastvale Logging Camp, where danger keeps the work from going smoothly. Wolves and bears drive lumberjacks from the eastern woods, but the camp still sends timber to Stormwind and nearby settlements.

sections.title: A Vital Operation Under Siege
sections.body:
Timber buyers across the Kingdom of Stormwind send Eastvale Logging Camp orders with strict deadlines. Wolves and bears prowl the woods around the work sites. They drive lumberjacks away and leave cut timber behind.

Supervisor Raelen directs the camp’s work. Travelers help drive off the beasts and recover the abandoned wood before deliveries fall behind schedule.

sections.title: Life on the Eastern Frontier
sections.body:
Eastvale Logging Camp has homes and horse stables where travelers can buy fine mounts. On a nearby hill above the work site, retired Marshal Haggard lives in a quiet manor.

He once led the Stormwind Guard. Then he left its service to retire far from the capital’s politics.

faq.q: What is the main purpose of Eastvale Logging Camp?
faq.answer: Eastvale Logging Camp supplies timber to the Kingdom of Stormwind from eastern Elwynn Forest. Its lumberjacks work long hours to meet strict deadlines and supply builders and nobles across the realm.

faq.q: Why is the logging camp always hiring adventurers?
faq.answer: Wolves and bears menace workers in the dense woods around Eastvale Logging Camp. Their attacks drive lumberjacks away from cut timber and put orders at risk of missing shipment deadlines.
Marshal Haggard is the retired former leader of the Stormwind Guard. He left the service a few years ago and now lives in a peaceful estate on the bluffs above Eastvale Logging Camp.

faq.q: Can you buy mounts at Eastvale Logging Camp?
faq.answer: Yes. The horse stable at Eastvale Logging Camp sells riding horses and offers riding training.

angles.text: As a human of Stormwind, you rely on Eastvale’s timber to rebuild and maintain the kingdom’s settlements.
At Eastvale Logging Camp, you can buy dependable Stormwind steeds.
